page.overview:
Who is Hitch Trailblazer?

Hitch Trailblazer is a male Earth pony and one of the main characters of My Little Pony: A New Generation and My Little Pony Generation 5. He is the law-keeping sheriff of Maretime Bay and a childhood friend of Sunny Starscout. As of My Little Pony: Make Your Mark, he is the adoptive father of the baby dragon Sparky Sparkeroni.__TOC__

Hitch Trailblazer was designed by character artist Celia Kaspar. During the film's concept phase, Hitch was known as simply "The Protector".

Hasbro filed a trademark for the name "Hitch Trailblazer" with the United States Patent and Trademark Office on February 25, 2021.

In the film My Little Pony: A New Generation, Hitch first appears as a young colt and friend to Sunny Starscout and Sprout. Like most other Earth ponies, Hitch has been taught to view unicorns and Pegasi as dangerous enemies, though he is willing to play along with Sunny's games where all the pony races are friends, and attempts to mediate Sunny and Sprout's wildly differing views on the subject.
